messages:
raj (eng-security): heads up, seeing a spike of S3 GETs from analytics-service into /customers/PII/ since 09:02 UTC :rotating_light:
sarah (eng-infra): which role is calling? any IAM principal info from logs?
raj (eng-security): principal arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/analytics-service-role/session-abc123 — looks like a role-binding change merged ~08:57 (PR #4821) that altered `analytics-service-role` inheritance
alex (platform): deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-20T08:58:12 completed for analytics-service (sha: a1b2c3)
deploy-bot: deployment event recorded: analytics-service v3.4.1 by @alex
mike (eng-sre): immediate mitigation: can we revoke that role binding or remove read scope from the role?
sarah (eng-infra): I can patch the role binding to remove the `s3:ListBucket`/`s3:GetObject` on the PII path. doing `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name analytics-service-role --policy-document file://deny-pii.json` now
sarah (eng-infra): applied deny policy, also detaching inline policy that inherited from `platform-common`
raj (eng-security): please also revoke active STS sessions for that role: `aws sts revoke-session-token` (or rotate role creds). mike — can you block network egress to s3 for that pod as additional containment?
mike (eng-sre): patched networkpolicy to deny egress to s3 for analytics ns, rolling now. pax 1/3 pods still up
alex (platform): rolling back PR #4821 to be safe, will open revert PR in 5m
jenna (product): any users affected? is this an integrity/data-exfil or just internal processing? we need to triage customer impact
raj (eng-security): looks like reads only from a historical bucket. potential exposure of PII objects — starting audit to enumerate keys accessed between 08:57-09:12. query: `aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-prod-customer --prefix customers/` then grep by requester from CloudTrail
leo (legal): please preserve logs and don't notify customers yet until we confirm scope. collect exact object keys and count of distinct customer IDs accessed
tess (customer-success): if this becomes customer-impacting we'll need comms draft asap. ready to help once scope confirmed
sarah (eng-infra): CloudTrail shows ~142 `GetObject` calls from that principal to `customers/PII/` range. exporting to s3://redwood-incident-exports/2019-03-20/analytcs-pii.csv
raj (eng-security): initial containment done: role denies + networkpolicy + revert PR queued. next: rotate any KMS grants for analytics-service, audit KMS decrypt logs, and snapshot affected objects. assign owners?
alex (platform): i'll handle PR revert and KMS grant rotation. creating checklist in ops doc.
mike (eng-sre): i'll finish egress block and run `kubectl delete pod -l app=analytics-service` to clear tokens
leo (legal): log retention: preserve CloudTrail logs and do not purge any S3 object versions. also start a legal hold on the incident folder.
raj (eng-security): tagging this Sev2 for now. after we have list of customer IDs we can decide on notification. can folks ack ownership here: containment= sarah/mike, investigation=raj/alex, comms=tess/jenna, legal=leo
jenna (product): ack comms owner. please send me the PII object count and example keys (redact full keys in public channels)
sarah (eng-infra): containment complete at 09:14 UTC. networkpolicy enforced, role denies in place, revert PR opened (#4823).
raj (eng-security): thanks. next actions: full access audit, KMS decrypt logs, session revocations, prepare draft notification if >50 customers impacted. will start postmortem template after triage
alex (platform): noted, rotating KMS grants now and revoking role sessions. ETA 20m
deploy-bot: policy-change detected: inline role policy detached from analytics-service-role (actor: sarah)
raj (eng-security): final note — after rollback we should add a CI check to prevent role inheritance from `platform-common` to service roles without an explicit allowlist. adding issue for policy guardrail
jenna (product): thanks team. keep me updated on scope. if customers >50 we'll coordinate legal + support comms.
leo (legal): acknowledged.
raj (eng-security): closing thread here once postmortem created. will ping channel with link.
summary: Emergency triage for analytics-service role change that allowed S3 PII reads; containment (role deny, network policy, PR revert), investigation (CloudTrail + KMS audit), and actions assigned.
